description: This file defines the ResourceKey interface, representing a resource's key within the Eclipse Ditto policies model. It provides static factory methods for creating resource keys, methods for retrieving resource type and path, and defaults for JSON schema handling.

classes.name: ResourceKey
classes.description: An interface representing a resource's key, providing methods to create and access resource type and path information.

methods.name: newInstance(CharSequence typeWithPath)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from a string containing type and path separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: newInstance(CharSequence type, CharSequence path)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from separate type and path strings.

methods.name: getResourceType()
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this key.

methods.name: getResourcePath()
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer object.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition()
methods.description: Provides the JSON field definition for this ResourceKey using the JsonFactory.
